C0400.title: Beijing Police Dismantle a Criminal Gang Providing 'Account Farming' and Other Underground Cyber Services
C0400.summary: In June 2021, the Mentougou cyber security division of Beijing police discovered individuals developing specialized software for 'account farming' and 'group spamming,' offering underground cyber services to downstream crimes. The gang used technical means to bulk-maintain account activity and lower risk scores, supplying these accounts for use in fraud, gambling, and other illegal activities.
